observations: Geller and Cook, Biological Psychiatry (2000), studied COMT Val/Met transmission in pediatric/early-adolescent bipolar disorder.

entities.name: No COMT TDT association
observations: In 52 prepubertal/early-adolescent bipolar probands (ultradian rapid cycling in 75%), transmission disequilibrium tests found no preferential transmission of the low-activity COMT allele to the ultradian-cycling subgroup or the full sample; tests were nonsignificant.
